tasks.title: Scaffold crates/ffscene and define the core scene types
tasks.description: Create Cargo.toml with workspace inheritance, forbid(unsafe_code), deny(missing_docs), and a crate doc that states scope and non-goals. Define Canvas, Rational, Background, Scene, Layer, LayerId, SourceId, Transform, BlendMode, EncoderProfile, Codec, RateControl, Ladder, Rung, Output, CompiledGraph, and CompileError with stable error codes. Keep the crate dependency-free.

tasks.title: Implement scene validation before compilation
tasks.description: Add a validation pass that rejects cycles, unknown SourceIds, transforms outside the canvas bounds, non-finite opacity, and unsupported blend modes. Return CompileError variants that carry the layer ID and a stable code, and never produce a partial graph.

tasks.title: Implement deterministic graph and argument compilation
tasks.description: Build the filter graph from a normalised layer order (z, layer id, source id). Emit scale, crop, overlay, blend, format, and setpts nodes with stable labels, then produce filter_complex, the input and output label vectors, the argument vector, and the LayerLabelMap. Emit no timestamps or process-specific values and use ordered collections only.

tasks.title: Implement encoder ladder expansion
tasks.description: Expand a Ladder into one EncoderProfile per rung, inserting split followed by ordered scale nodes. Keep rung order stable and produce one output label per rung. Reject empty ladders and duplicate rung names with a typed error.

tasks.title: Implement the encoder probe and explicit downgrade report
tasks.description: Accept an injected list of available encoders so no FFmpeg binary is required at build time, and select the requested encoder or report the fallback explicitly. Return a result that names the selected encoder, the requested encoder, and the reason for any downgrade. Never fall back silently.

tasks.title: Implement output descriptors without transport
tasks.description: Define Output::{File, Rtmp, Srt, Whip} as data only. Compilation must not resolve DNS, open sockets, or spawn processes. Validate descriptor shape (path presence, URL scheme, stream key presence) and keep connection health in rtmp-publish.

tasks.title: Add the ffscene README, changelog, and compile example
tasks.description: Add README.md describing scope, non-goals, the FFmpeg 7.x dialect boundary, determinism guarantees, and a usage sketch. Add CHANGELOG.md and examples/compile_scene.rs that builds an in-memory scene, compiles it, and prints the argument vector with no network or process access.

tasks.title: Scaffold crates/mixbus with pre-allocated buffers and typed errors
tasks.description: Create the crate manifest, lints, crate docs, Mixer, MixerConfig, Bus, Source, Frame, BlockSize, and MixError. Pre-allocate all buffers at the maximum block size during construction. Define a bounded command queue for control changes. The crate has no required dependencies.

tasks.title: Implement gain and constant-power pan
tasks.description: Implement per-source and per-bus gain in dB with a linear conversion, and constant-power stereo panning. Keep the math branch-light and free of allocation. Sanitise NaN and infinite input to finite values and raise a meter flag.

tasks.title: Implement the gate and compressor
tasks.description: Implement a noise gate with threshold, hysteresis, attack, hold, and release, plus a compressor with threshold, ratio, attack, release, and makeup gain. Keep per-sample state in the pre-allocated plan and do not allocate or log.

tasks.title: Implement the sidechain ducker
tasks.description: Implement Duck with a key source, threshold, ratio, attack, and release. Read only the key source's detector value from the current block, apply gain reduction to the target source, and avoid pumping by using the configured attack and release.

tasks.title: Implement EBU R128 loudness and true-peak limiting
tasks.description: Implement K-weighting, gated integrated loudness, and a true-peak limiter with a configurable ceiling. Report LUFS and true peak through the meter snapshot. Handle digital silence without violating the ceiling.

tasks.title: Implement off-thread plan rebuild, block-boundary swap, and latency compensation
tasks.description: Build a new MixPlan on the control thread when routing changes, then swap it at the next block boundary through an atomic exchange. Sum insert latency and delay parallel paths so outputs remain aligned. The audio thread must only read the active plan and drain the bounded queue.

tasks.title: Implement lock-free meter snapshots
tasks.description: Publish peak, RMS, LUFS, gain reduction, and flags per block into a double-buffered snapshot with an atomic index. Readers load a snapshot without locking and never call into the processing path. Include per-bus and per-source meters.

tasks.title: Add the mixbus README, changelog, and process example
tasks.description: Document the real-time rules, the buffer contract, latency, and the meter model. Add CHANGELOG.md and examples/process_block.rs that synthesises a block, mixes two sources with ducking, and prints meters without device access.

tasks.title: Scaffold crates/replay-recorder with track types and the packet API
tasks.description: Create the manifest, lints, crate docs, Recorder, RecorderConfig, SessionId, TrackId, Track, TrackCodec, Container, Packet, Sink, DiskBudget, PressurePolicy, ClipHandle, and RecorderError. Define the packet-in API and per-track start and stop.

tasks.title: Implement the spool layout, ID path safety, and atomic index
tasks.description: Write spool/<session-id>/track-<id>/seg-<n>.<ext> and index.json. Derive every path from validated newtypes and reject traversal, separators, reserved names, and absolute paths. Write the index to a temporary file and rename it after each segment close.

tasks.title: Implement segment writing and monotonic timestamps
tasks.description: Open, write, and close segments by duration or size. Track per-track sequence numbers so a wall-clock change cannot produce negative or non-monotonic durations. Default to MKV and allow MP4 per track. Record codec, container, start, duration, and byte length in the index.

tasks.title: Implement the tee sink
tasks.description: Duplicate each encoded segment to the configured outputs. Write the local segment first, then the duplicate, and record both paths in the index. Propagate write failures as typed errors without leaving an index entry for a missing file.

tasks.title: Implement ring rotation and clip extraction
tasks.description: Keep a bounded set of recent segments per ring track. clip(last) selects the covering range, concatenates the segment payloads into a self-contained file, and returns a ClipHandle without pausing the writer. Bound the window by both seconds and bytes.

tasks.title: Implement the disk budget and pressure policies
tasks.description: Check max_bytes and min_free_bytes before opening a segment and periodically during writes. Apply StopOldest, StopNewest, or Refuse, emit a typed PressureEvent, delete partial files, and never let free space fall below min_free_bytes.

tasks.title: Implement crash recovery
tasks.description: Scan the spool on construction, validate the index against the files, finalise a segment that has a complete header and trailer, and discard a partial segment deterministically. Rewrite the index atomically and expose a recovery report.

tasks.title: Add the replay-recorder README, changelog, and record-and-clip example
tasks.description: Document the spool layout, the single-writer-per-track contract, the budget semantics, and recovery. Add CHANGELOG.md and examples/record_and_clip.rs that records synthetic packets into a temporary spool, extracts a clip, and prints the paths.

tasks.title: Scaffold crates/studio-protocol with the envelope, IDs, messages, and JSON serde
tasks.description: Create the manifest with optional serde, serde_json, uuid (v7), and chrono dependencies. Define Envelope, MessageId, ParticipantId, TenantId, Message, the payload structs, and the JSON encoding. Use deny_unknown_fields on payloads and keep the wire shape documented.

tasks.title: Implement permissions and the role table
tasks.description: Define Permission, Role, and a single role-to-permission table. Expose check(role, message) -> Result<(), Rejected> and call it before every transition. Document that the check is server-side and that a client button state is never enforcement.

tasks.title: Implement the pure state machine and atomic program cut
tasks.description: Define StudioState with program, preview, participants, overlays, and seen IDs. Implement apply(state, envelope, actor) -> Result<StudioState, Rejected> as a pure function. The program cut swaps program and preview in one assignment so no observable state has both.

tasks.title: Implement version negotiation
tasks.description: Encode the protocol version as one integer where the major is v / 100 and the minor is v % 100, and document it in the crate. Reject an unknown major and accept a higher minor with additive fields. Cover the Envelope and every payload.

tasks.title: Implement duplicate and out-of-order handling
tasks.description: Reject a duplicate MessageId idempotently with Rejected::Duplicate. Reject scene and overlay messages older than the last applied sequence for that actor, except Ping and Pong, and document the rule. Keep the seen-ID set bounded.

tasks.title: Implement the per-participant message budget
tasks.description: Implement a fixed-window counter per participant with the 50 messages-per-second budget. Return Rejected::RateLimited when exhausted. Do not grow a queue; the caller decides whether to drop or retry.

tasks.title: Add the studio-protocol README, changelog, and message-log example
tasks.description: Document the message table, the permission matrix, the version rule, and the ordering rule. Add CHANGELOG.md and examples/replay_log.rs that applies a short JSON message log and prints the final state.

tasks.title: Scaffold crates/rtmp-publish with destination, secret, and redacted types
tasks.description: Create the manifest, lints, crate docs, DestinationId, Destination, Protocol, SecretString, Health, RetryPolicy, CircuitBreaker, BitrateHint, and PublishError. Implement Debug and Display by hand so the key prints ***; do not implement Serialize for the key. Provide RedactedDestination as the only serialisable view.

tasks.title: Implement destination shape validation with the TLS policy
tasks.description: Validate protocol, scheme, host, port, and key presence. Accept rtmp, rtmps, srt, srt://, whip+https, and https for WHIP; reject plaintext credential schemes. Return a typed PublishError before any connection attempt. Document HSTS as an edge responsibility.

tasks.title: Implement TCP and WHIP probes with health classification
tasks.description: Probe RTMP, RTMPS, and SRT with a TCP connect and WHIP with an HTTP OPTIONS or HEAD request behind the optional reqwest feature with rustls-tls. Classify DNS failure, refused, timeout, TLS failure, and auth rejection into distinct Health variants. Accept an injected connector and timeout for deterministic behaviour.

tasks.title: Implement bounded retry with jitter and the circuit breaker
tasks.description: Implement base * 2^attempt with a cap and injected jitter. Retry transport failures only and never retry AuthRejected. Track failures per destination, open the breaker, and close it after a success or a cool-down.

tasks.title: Implement failover and cool-down
tasks.description: Promote the backup when the primary breaker opens and demote it only after the cool-down. Refuse self-referential backups and backup cycles. Keep promotion decisions in one state machine so the result does not flap.

tasks.title: Implement bounded bitrate hints
tasks.description: Given observed throughput, produce a hint between the configured floor and ceiling. Never exceed the ceiling or drop below the floor. Keep the calculation pure and documented.

tasks.title: Add the rtmp-publish README, changelog, and destination example
tasks.description: Document redaction guarantees, the supported protocols, probe depth, retry semantics, and failover. Add CHANGELOG.md and examples/plan_destination.rs that validates a destination, prints the redacted view, and computes a health plan without connecting.

tasks.title: Scaffold crates/signedlink with claims, signer, code, store, and typed errors
tasks.description: Create the manifest with hmac, sha2, base64, getrandom, url, optional serde, and optional axum. Define Signer, SigningKey, Claims, Code, SignedUrl, LinkStore, LinkError, and the canonical claim encoding. Redact the key and token in Debug.

tasks.title: Implement HMAC-SHA256 signing, constant-time verification, expiry, and clock skew
tasks.description: Canonicalise claims with sorted UTM parameters and a format version, sign with HMAC-SHA256, and encode URL-safe without padding. Verify with a constant-time comparison, reject a modified payload or MAC, enforce expiry with a closed boundary, and accept only the configured clock skew.

tasks.title: Implement base62 code generation with bounded collision retry
tasks.description: Generate base62 codes from OS entropy through getrandom. Check existence through LinkStore::get, retry up to a documented limit, and return CodeExhausted after the limit. Document that the code is an identifier and the signature is the authorisation.

tasks.title: Implement UTM normalisation and the attribution window
tasks.description: Accept exactly utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_term, and utm_content. Sort deterministically, normalise casing consistently, and reject unknown keys. Carry the attribution window in claims without inventing a default.

tasks.title: Implement single-use nonce consumption and revocation
tasks.description: Add LinkStore::consume(code) -> bool for atomic single use and LinkStore::revoke(code). Reject consumed, revoked, and missing codes with distinct errors. Document the parameterised-query obligation for store implementations.

tasks.title: Implement the optional axum redirect handler with no-referrer
tasks.description: Behind the axum feature, add a handler that resolves the code, verifies the link, records the click hook, and redirects. Set Referrer-Policy: no-referrer and Cache-Control: no-store. Do not downgrade the target scheme and do not leak the token.

tasks.title: Add the signedlink README, changelog, and sign-and-verify example
tasks.description: Document the token format, the store requirement, revocation semantics, the UTM contract, and the redirect headers. Add CHANGELOG.md and examples/sign_and_verify.rs with an in-memory store showing sign, verify, tamper rejection, and revocation.

tasks.title: Add metadata, READMEs, changelogs, docs.rs configuration, and packaging settings to all six crates
tasks.description: For each crate, add description, keywords, categories, readme, licence, repository, include list, and [package.metadata.docs.rs] all-features = true. Add a README and CHANGELOG. Confirm cargo package --workspace succeeds. Do not edit the root manifest: crates/* already covers the crates.

tasks.title: Verify every example builds without network or device access
tasks.description: Build each examples/*.rs target and confirm it compiles with no network, device, FFmpeg binary, or external process. This is a manual and compile check; it does not run tests.

tasks.title: Verify the feature matrix with cargo check
tasks.description: Run cargo check --workspace --no-default-features and then each crate with each feature enabled independently. Fix any accidental coupling and document the default feature set.

tasks.title: Run the formatter, clippy with -D warnings, and rustdoc with warnings denied
tasks.description: Run cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --workspace --all-features -- -D warnings, and RUSTDOCFLAGS=-D warnings cargo doc --workspace --all-features. Fix the findings. Do not invoke a test runner in this task.

tasks.title: Perform the manual security baseline review
tasks.description: Read every public entry point and confirm keys are redacted, no secret implements Serialize, schemes are TLS-only, no .env or committed key exists, path IDs are validated, and the LinkStore contract documents parameterised access. Record the review in the pull request description.

tasks.title: Verify CI coverage and the dependency rules
tasks.description: Confirm .github/workflows/ci.yml runs the workspace jobs over the new crates without a workflow edit. Check the dependency tree: no wirekit, no global mutable singleton, and one job per crate.
